meta.name: a11y-audit
meta.description: Accessibility audit skill for scanning, fixing, and verifying WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA compliance across React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain HTML codebases. Use when auditing accessibility, fixing a11y violations, checking color contrast, generating compliance reports, or integrating accessibility checks into CI/CD pipelines.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描并修复网页无障碍违规，生成合规报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发中确保网站符合WCAG无障碍标准
copy.tagline_en: Scan and fix web accessibility violations, generate compliance reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your website meets WCAG accessibility standards during development

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能扫描你的代码，找出所有 WCAG 2.2 A 级和 AA 级无障碍违规问题，并给出修复前后的代码示例。它还能检查颜色对比度、生成合规报告，并支持集成到 CI/CD 流程中。
howto.when: 当你要求审计代码的无障碍性、修复无障碍违规、检查颜色对比度、生成合规报告，或希望将无障碍检查加入 CI/CD 流水线时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个项目的无障碍问题。
say.note: Claude 会运行扫描并列出违规项。

say.text: 检查这段代码的颜色对比度是否达标。
say.note: Claude 会使用对比度检查工具验证。

say.text: 生成一份无障碍合规报告。
say.note: Claude 会输出结构化报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan your codebase for all WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA accessibility violations, provide before/after code fixes, check color contrast, generate compliance reports, and integrate into CI/CD pipelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit code accessibility, fix a11y violations, check color contrast, generate compliance reports, or integrate accessibility checks into CI/CD.

say_en.text: Scan this project for accessibility issues.
say_en.note: Claude will run the scanner and list violations.

say_en.text: Check if this code's color contrast passes.
say_en.note: Claude will use the contrast checker tool.
Claude will output a structured report.
